name: Generic MIDI
notes: Complete list: 7 actions and 15 feedbacks. The note, CC, program, pitch and SysEx entries are generated in a loop over midiMsgTypes (src/operations.ts, src/actions.ts:12, src/feedbacks.ts:15) and are written out one by one here; the msc action and the feedbacks midiIn, midiOut, msc and msc_value are defined explicitly.

Options come from createOptions (src/operations.ts:92-145): channel (1-16, default 1), note (0-127, default 60), controller (0-127, default 127) and the value field (id velocity, value or program; SysEx uses the textinput bytes). The commented-out message types (aftertouch, channel pressure, MTC, clock, ...) are not registered.

Actions other than sysex add varValue/relValue/sendOverTime/timeStartValue/time/curve; the static-text field relText ('Relative will only work after a value has been sent from the device!') is not catalogued. The checkboxes relValue and sendOverTime set disableAutoExpression; visibleWhen texts are the source isVisibleExpression strings.

Because the number fields have no required flag and always have a default, nothing is marked required. Relative values need an incoming value from the device (the module stores incoming messages in a data store); the module also creates variables, which are not catalogued.
SysEx bytes (action and feedback): decimal or 0x-hex tokens separated by spaces or commas, integers 0-255, first F0 (240), last F7 (247).

MSC: commandFormat and command ids are numbers (0x01 = 1, ...); the action defaults are 0x10 (16, Sound General) and 0x01 (1, GO). The data text is hex bytes (needs at least one '0x' token) or ASCII with '|' as field separator (encoded as NUL). encodeMsc rejects ids above 0x7f and messages longer than 128 bytes (src/midi/msc.ts:112-124). The feedbacks use -1 for 'Any'.
The module talks to a MIDI port (in and out, optionally virtual) chosen in the connection config; port names are config fields, not action options.
Built on @companion-module/base ~2.1.0: options support expressions, except fields with disableAutoExpression.

actions.name: Note Off
actions.description: Relative: sends the stored incoming value plus varValue and only works after the device sent a value. Send Over Time: ramps from the start value (or the stored value when relative) to the target in steps of 15 ms with the chosen curve; the end value is clamped to 0-127 (src/actions.ts:45-120).

options.label: SysEx Bytes
options.description: Enter a string of decimal or hex digits, with spaces or commas between. MUST start with 0xF0 or 240 and end with 0xF7 or 247

actions.description: Bytes are parsed from the text: split on whitespace or commas, '0x' prefix means hex, each byte must be an integer 0-255, the first must be 0xF0 and the last 0xF7 (src/actions.ts:24-41); otherwise a warning is logged and nothing is sent.

options.label: Data (ASCII; use | between fields, or enter hex bytes)
